tools.name: ask_9bot_assistant
tools.description: Prepares a question about 9bot features, pricing, setup, integrations, WhatsApp automation, or MCP in the visible 9bot assistant. The user reviews the question before sending it.

tools.name: browse_9bot_articles
tools.description: Opens the official 9bot catalog of articles, WhatsApp guides, MCP documentation, and free resources in the selected language.

language.description: Language for the article catalog. When omitted, the current page language is used.

tools.name: explore_9bot_feature
tools.description: Opens the official 9bot product section for dashboard, automations, Workflows, scheduling, reports, or MCP. Use it when a user wants details about one product capability.

language.description: Language for the product page. When omitted, the current page language is used.

tools.name: explore_9bot_mcp
tools.description: Opens a specific section of the official 9bot MCP documentation, including overview, capabilities, Workflows, examples, clients, connection, security, tools, or FAQ.

language.description: Language for the MCP page. When omitted, the current page language is used.

tools.name: ninebot_get_agent_endpoints
tools.description: Returns the official public 9bot MCP, OAuth, OpenAPI, WebMCP, Agent Skills, A2A, Auth.md, ARD, and llms.txt discovery locations. Use it when an agent needs authoritative 9bot integration endpoints.

tools.name: ninebot_get_authentication_info
tools.description: Returns public 9bot OAuth discovery locations and supported high-level access scopes without reading or exposing credentials. Use it before connecting an AI client to the protected 9bot MCP server.

tools.name: ninebot_get_capabilities
tools.description: Describes public 9bot capability areas for WhatsApp groups, communities, messages, automation, scheduling, Workflows, moderation, analytics, integrations, security, and agent interfaces. Use it to evaluate which 9bot area fits a task.

area.description: Capability area to return. Choose all for the complete public capability summary.

tools.name: open_9bot_free_tool
tools.description: Opens a free 9bot generator for WhatsApp group rules, customer messages, general messages, links, channel descriptions, group invitations, business bios, group announcements, quick replies, or QR codes.

language.description: Preferred language for the tool. When omitted, the current page language is used.

tools.name: start_9bot_trial
tools.description: Opens the official page to review plans, connect WhatsApp, and start the seven-day 9bot trial in the selected language. It does not confirm a subscription or payment.

language.description: Language for the official 9bot trial page. When omitted, the current page language is used.
